excluded_columns: time_delta (as-provided broken column; replaced by causal stream dt_s -> log_dt)

feature_descriptions.fc_k: one-hot Modbus function code k (k in 1..6); fc_other for any other code
feature_descriptions.modbus_len: Modbus length field as parsed (verified column modbus_len)
feature_descriptions.register_start: starting register/coil address field (verified column register_start)
feature_descriptions.packet_size: frame size in bytes (verified column packet_size)
feature_descriptions.d_reg: register_start minus register_start of previous packet in the window (0 at t=0)
feature_descriptions.seq_step: 1 if d_reg == +1 (sequential forward address step) else 0 (0 at t=0)
feature_descriptions.back_step: 1 if d_reg < 0 (backward address step) else 0 (0 at t=0)
feature_descriptions.fc_change: 1 if func_code differs from previous packet in the window else 0 (0 at t=0)
feature_descriptions.log_dt: log10(max(dt_s, 1e-6)); dt_s = recomputed inter-packet time (s) within window; NaN at t=0 (imputed to training mean 0.0 after standardisation)
feature_descriptions.d_log_dt: log_dt[t] minus log_dt[t-1] within window (NaN at t=0,1; imputed to 0.0 after standardisation)
feature_descriptions.duration_s: window end timestamp minus start timestamp (s)
feature_descriptions.dt_mean/std/min/max/cv: statistics of the L-1 within-window inter-packet intervals; cv=std/mean
feature_descriptions.polling_drift: mean log_dt of second half of within-window intervals minus first half
feature_descriptions.n_unique_fc/n_unique_reg: distinct function codes / register addresses in window
feature_descriptions.seq_step_ratio/back_step_ratio/fc_change: fraction of within-window steps (L-1) with that indicator
feature_descriptions.log_qty_mean/max: mean/max of log1p(quantity) across the L packets
feature_descriptions.write_ratio: fraction of write function codes across the L packets
feature_descriptions.fc_frac_k: fraction of packets in window with function code k
